title: O Rejoice in The Lord
lyrics_original: In darkness He giveth a song.
Of each path that I take,
For when I am tried and purified,
I shall come forth as gold.
So I looked at the cross
Of each path that I take,
For when I am tried and purified,
I shall come forth as gold.
And I trust in His care;
Of each path that I take,
For when I am tried and purified,
I shall come forth as gold.

bible_verses.english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance. Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, thank You for holding every detail of my life with perfect wisdom and love. Even when the journey feels long or dark, help me remember that You are faithfully shaping my heart. Give me the grace to trust Your sovereign plan and find true joy in Your presence today. I rest in the truth that You make no mistakes and know the end of my path. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Even in our darkest moments, God works with gentle intentionality to shape our hearts and strengthen our faith. We often cannot see the full picture, but we can trust that He never allows a season of testing without a loving purpose behind it. As you sing today, let your soul rest in the quiet confidence that the Lord makes no mistakes on the path He has chosen for you. Choose to rejoice, knowing He holds your future securely in His hands.
